appearance.interfaceDescription: Basic hides advanced actions like stash, rebase, and terminal. Advanced shows everything.
appearance.themeDescription: Choose a color palette for the application interface.
appearance.basicDescription: Essential Git actions only. Hides stash, rebase, cherry-pick, tags, and more.
appearance.advancedDescription: Full toolbar, sidebar sections, and commit actions.

language.title: Language
language.systemDescription: Follow your operating system language. Currently {language}.

layout.description: Control panel visibility and restore the default three-pane layout.
layout.showLeftSidebarDescription: Display the branch sidebar on the left.
layout.showRightPanelDescription: Display the working tree and diff panel on the right.
layout.resetDescription: Restore default panel sizes and expand both side panels.

changes.description: Control how changed files are listed in the working tree and commit panels.
changes.treeViewDescription: Group changed files in a collapsible folder hierarchy.

commits.description: Default options applied to new commits.
commits.signOffDescription: Add a Signed-off-by trailer to commit messages (--signoff).
commits.signDescription: Sign with GPG/SSH key (-S). Requires user.signingkey in git config.

commitGraph.description: Control which commits appear in the graph and which columns are shown.
commitGraph.showAllBranchesDescription: Display commits from every branch, not just the checked-out branch.
commitGraph.recentCommitsDescription: Maximum number of commits fetched for the graph. Minimum {min}; {recommended} recommended.
commitGraph.columnsDescription: Choose which optional columns are shown in the graph rows.
commitGraph.timeIndicatorsDescription: Show dividers like “a week ago” between commits in the graph.
commitGraph.mergeIndicatorsDescription: Mark merge commits with a merge icon in the commit message column.
commitGraph.columnWidthsDescription: Exact pixel widths, or drag the column edges in the graph header.

columnDescriptions.author: Show the commit author avatar and name in each row.
columnDescriptions.sha: Show the abbreviated commit hash in each row.
columnDescriptions.when: Show how long ago each commit was made.

sidebar.description: Choose how each branch sidebar section is shown: expanded, collapsed to its header, or hidden entirely.

sectionDescriptions.favorites: Pinned branches shown at the top of the sidebar.
sectionDescriptions.localBranches: Local branch list and branch groups.
sectionDescriptions.tags: Annotated and lightweight tags in the repository.
sectionDescriptions.stashes: Saved stashes with message and branch context.
sectionDescriptions.worktrees: Linked worktrees and their checkout paths.

sync.description: Keep remote-tracking branches fresh without leaving the app.
sync.autoFetchIntervalDescription: Silently fetch all remotes on a schedule. No banner, no toast — the graph just updates.

credits.description: Free, open-source desktop Git client (Tauri 2, Vue 3, TypeScript, Rust) — graph-first alternative to GitKraken with commit graph, branches, staging and real local Git operations.
credits.openSourceDescription: Git Light is made possible by these projects and their contributors.

dracula.label: Dracula
dracula.description: Classic Dracula theme with purple and pink accents.

light.label: Light
light.description: Clean light palette inspired by GitHub and VS Code.

claude.label: Claude
claude.description: Dark warm charcoal palette inspired by claude.ai.

tokyo-night.label: Tokyo Night
tokyo-night.description: Dark blue Tokyo Night palette with vivid blue and purple accents.

shortcuts.description: Click a shortcut to record a new one. Esc cancels. Conflicts are highlighted.
shortcuts.recordingHint: Press keys for shortcut, Esc to cancel
